description: Search the whole classical Islamic library (8,594 works, no scope) and get up to 10 pages as {id, title, url}; pass an id to `fetch` to read the page. This is the generic one-argument entry (the standard search/fetch pair); the scoped tools answer research questions better. Use shamela_search_library for a hadith, tafsir or fiqh question: unscoped ranking is by term frequency, so a poetry anthology can outrank Sahih al-Bukhari. Use shamela_search (match "words", "phrase", "near", "exact" or "boolean") to pin books, categories or a madhhab, match an exact or diacritized phrase, or page further; use shamela_cite (mode "printed_page") for printed-page citations. Exact phrase first; only when it finds nothing are the words matched separately. Title flags: [footnote match] = only an editor's footnote; [token match] = words occur apart; [near match] = only some words or their roots. Empty results mean no page carries the words. A query without Arabic words returns a tool error.

query.description: Arabic search text, e.g. "إنما الأعمال بالنيات"; 2-6 words work best. Quote the wording if known, else name the topic.

name: search

results.description: At most 10 pages; empty when no page carries the words.

title.description: "{book} — {author} ({volume}/{page})", plus [footnote match], [token match] or [near match] when the match is weaker than the exact phrase in the main text.

title: Quick generic search of the whole library
